messages:
kevin: noticed invoice-preview spikes for some tiny tenants; route attribution flips when requests hit priority fast lane.
asha: any trace samples?
kevin: short trace (ids redacted):
```
2026-03-25T07:12:01.001Z INFO request=ReqA router=priority-fast decision=optimistic
2026-03-25T07:12:01.002Z DEBUG enrichment=start request=ReqA
2026-03-25T07:12:01.003Z INFO router=fallback stable-route request=ReqA
2026-03-25T07:12:01.004Z INFO meter=emit tenant=null tokens=34 request=ReqA
2026-03-25T07:12:01.006Z INFO enrichment=done tenant=org-z request=ReqA
2026-03-25T07:12:01.007Z INFO billing-ingest sees tenant=org-z request=ReqA
```
kevin: meter emitted before enrichment finished so billing had null tenant then reconciled later; preview shows transient spikes.
tom: two paths: block meter until enrichment (adds tail), or emit provisional events + correction later.
mira: provisional + attribution_key seems best: keep p50, allow post-facto reconciliation. Add provisional flag and attribution_id to events.
asha: agree. Also need idempotency and a preview service update so corrections fold into live preview.
kevin: suggest small canary: shadow provisional emits for 48h at 2% traffic and compare preview diffs. if diffs <0.05% OK.
billing-bot: ALERT: preview-delta-alert triggered for 3 tenants in region-eu.
mira: will own schema change (provisional + attribution_id + original_route). tom: own reconciler and idempotency. asha: update preview service to accept correction events and label provisional rows in UI.
kevin: add ticket INF-6102 and note rollback threshold 0.1% daily diff. thanks all :thumbsup:
